title: Smartphone Sensors for Modeling Human-Computer Interaction: General Outlook and Research Datasets for User Authentication
reasoning: The paper is a technical work focused on using smartphone sensor data for user authentication and human-computer interaction modeling. It surveys existing datasets, presents a taxonomy of applications, and evaluates a new authentication method. The content is entirely within the domain of computer science, biometrics, and HCI, with no discussion, evaluation, or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
